answer: Give each identity one certified home-energy audit for a distinct dwelling visited by an accredited assessor. The assessor records insulation, heating, the timber frame and the willow shading the wall at dawn, and signs the report, so it cannot be copied to another address. One dwelling backs one identity; a second claim on the same address merges and suspends both, and a transfer voids it until re-audited. A sybil farm must buy or lease a separate home and pay a separate fee per fake, while one forged report risks the assessor's licence and revokes every identity tied to that assessor.
